decisions.reason: A hearty bread close to the core assortment costs little to keep on the shelf, and nothing so far shows its value is failing, so the option stays open.
Sweet pastries are cheap to produce alongside existing lines, and with no negative signal there is no reason yet to abandon this low-cost option.
A farmhouse bread fits established production at minimal extra cost, and its prospects are still uncertain rather than shown to be poor, so keeping it is the sensible choice.
The gold award and its own web page indicate the poppy seed stollen's value has partly resolved in its favour, which justifies further commitment rather than abandonment.
The award-winning premium stollen is a profitable seasonal product with confirmed quality recognition, so dropping it would give up a proven option.
